source.original_title: 05/15/2026 - David Fouche & Harry Edmonds KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session
source.display_title: 05/15/2026 - David Fouche & Harry Edmonds KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session — Lost

setter.name: Kim Forbes-Sobers
setter.evidence: Rep: 'You spoke with Kim. He kind of gave me, like, an overview. I feel like I've got a head start.' Nothing specific from her notes was reflected back, and the prospect immediately revealed he did not know what the call was for.

prospect.name: David Fouche
prospect.location: Burgaw, near Wilmington, North Carolina, USA
prospect.family_status: Has twin boys just short of two years old.
prospect.training_background: An avid gym-goer for more than twenty years until COVID interrupted it. Got back into it partially afterwards, then stopped again. Says he has let himself go over the last couple of years. Not currently training to any schedule and cannot reliably protect the time he sets aside.
prospect.medical: Torn bicep, with a stated psychological residue rather than a physical one: 'then I got injured, tore my bicep, things, and just like never really mentally got over it fully.' Also reports 'bad body aches and pains', and the onset of anxiety since COVID: 'anxiety and things started kicking in, things that never really affected me before.' No timeline, treatment, clinician or current status was established for any of it — none of the three disclosures was asked about.

signals: Explicitly lost ground across a hard stretch: 'I used to be a pretty avid gym goer for 20 plus years. And then when COVID happened, I kind of put a damper on things'
Carries visible regret and names it himself: 'I've kind of let myself go these last couple of years'
A stacked set of causes — pandemic, anxiety, a torn bicep, then twin boys — rather than a single plateau
Wants a former self back: 'just trying to get in a better physical fitness and just kind of sort of get back into shape'
Distinguished from the prehab fighter: nothing acute is being fought, the damage is behind him and unrepaired
Blocked by self-belief rather than by money — price never came up at all

goals.text: Get back into better physical fitness and back into shape after letting himself go
Learn and mimic Trevor's kettlebell movements — what he thought he was signing up for

pains.text: Cannot protect training time — sets it aside and something always takes it: 'I might set out a little time to work out here, and then by the time that time comes, something comes up and I'm not able to'
Twin boys just under two years old absorbing his time
Anxiety that began after COVID and had never affected him before
A torn bicep he has never psychologically recovered from
Does not believe he is mentally ready to commit — 'I just mentally, I just don't think I'm there quite, quite yet'
Fears being a burden or wasting the rep's time, raised twice unprompted
Lost more than twenty years of training consistency across the pandemic and never fully returned

objections.raw_quote: I have no problem doing this stuff kind of on my own, but I just, I don't know, I just mentally, I just don't think I'm there quite, quite yet.
objections.rep_response: Accepted it and closed the call: 'It's fair, dude. It's fine. It's not a problem. Well, I hope you are, I hope you get there, man... I wish you the very best. And if you feel like you're there, you can always reach back out.' No move from the fear play was attempted.

objections.raw_quote: I think, I think I might have to take a little bit more time to think about it. I just, like I said, I just don't want to take anyone's time away from them. Just, I don't want to be a waste of time really, you know?
objections.rep_response: Asked one question — 'Why would you be a waste of time?' — which the prospect did not answer, and did not pursue it. No further move ran.

objections.raw_quote: I'm not sure exactly how. I don't much time I'll be able to put forth towards my workouts. I don't necessarily get to work out whenever I want to, the way I want to.
objections.rep_response: Clarified the delivery model — 'It's not like you have to be on Zoom call with us when you're working out. We just kind of guide you' — then converted it into a commitment challenge rather than exploring the constraint.

evidence: Prospect self-disqualified on readiness: 'I just mentally, I just don't think I'm there quite, quite yet'
Rep accepted and closed it out rather than working it: 'It's fair, dude. It's fine. It's not a problem... I wish you the very best'
No offer was ever presented, no price was mentioned, and no product of any kind was proposed
No follow-up call, date or trigger was set — the return path was left entirely to the prospect: 'if you feel like you're there, you can always reach back out'

Counter-evidence toward follow_up rather than lost: the prospect's actual words were 'I might have to take a little bit more time to think about it', which is a delay rather than a refusal. Recorded as lost because the rep applied a readiness gate and released him, and nothing remains scheduled on either side.
Prospect also revealed he did not know what the call was for: 'I wasn't sure what exactly this was when I first clicked on it'
outcome.next_step: None. The prospect was told to reach back out if he changes his mind. No follow-up booked, no date set, no product offered.

notable.note: Six minutes, three separate health disclosures — a torn bicep he 'never really mentally got over', bad body aches and pains, and post-COVID anxiety that 'never really affected me before' — and not one of them was asked about. The rep converted all of it into a commitment question: 'if you really want to get back in and that's something that's a high priority, we can help you out. But if it's not, we can't.' There is a defensible reading of this as good conduct: no pressure was applied to a vulnerable prospect and he was released kindly. There is a harder reading a principal should see: a man with a twenty-year training history, a lapsed identity and a stated fear of wasting people's time was answered with a willpower frame and given nothing at all — no consequence frame, no fear play, and notably no offer of the $200 self-guided product that this rep volunteered unprompted to three affluent, self-directed prospects earlier the same week. The prospect had described exactly that product as what he wanted: 'I was just kind of just more thinking maybe I can just learn and mimic some of his movements with the kettlebell.' He also did not know what the call was for, which is a setter-handover problem.

quality.notes: Severe for a short file. The rep's frame at 00:00:46 is split across both labels and the prospect's answer at 00:01:08 begins under the rep's label. The block at 00:03:29 attributes the prospect's bicep-tear disclosure to the rep, and 00:03:54-00:04:05 splits a single rep turn across both speakers. The transcriber renders a word as 'Fath' at 00:03:41 — 'I just don't know how much Fath I'd be able to put into this' — which appears elsewhere in this corpus as a corruption of 'fat' but here reads as 'faith' or 'time'; the intended word is not recoverable. Roles resolved from content.
